title: Maintain private, portable fictional character roleplay with coherent knowledge boundaries
summary: A user wants local-friendly fictional adult character dialogue with stable personas, portable cards/chats and long-term state, without relying on model tool calling. Reports suggest continuity and information leakage across characters need tests; no prevalence claim.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Character identity and relationships remain coherent over long sessions
acceptance_checks.method: Review scripted long-run scenes and note contradictions, hallucinations and drift

acceptance_checks.criterion: Character definitions and dialogue history can be transferred or exported
acceptance_checks.method: Export cards/chats and import into a second permitted environment

acceptance_checks.criterion: Private roleplay text remains locally stored unless cloud is explicitly selected
acceptance_checks.method: Audit storage, remote endpoints and actual outgoing traffic

acceptance_checks.criterion: A character cannot reference private facts known only to other fictional characters
acceptance_checks.method: Inject a secret into one character's scene, isolate context per character and test subsequent scenes

acceptance_checks.criterion: Lawful consenting-adult fictional scenes follow the requested tone when compatible models are used
acceptance_checks.method: Human review on a permissioned fixed test set; distinguish refusals from quality errors
